notes.text: Help: tap the ? at the top for a game-day checklist, answers to common questions and a link to the full guide. It works while the app is locked, too.
Full guide: every question step by step, for Android tablets, phones and iPad. It opens in your browser and works without wifi.
Settings › This device › Install Diamond DJ puts the app on your home screen with the Bees icon. If your device can't do it in one tap, it shows you the steps.
What's new and App history in Help: see what changed in each version.
When a new version is ready, a message tells you what's in it, with Update now and Later. It waits until nothing is playing. Small fixes install by themselves.
